rationale.conceptual: The task applies established DFT methods (vdW functional, phonon dispersion via finite displacements, band unfolding, intercalation voltage formula) to model Na insertion in carbon. It requires understanding of phonon selection rules, double resonance Raman conditions, and correct extraction of Γ-point and K-point energies. No novel algorithm is introduced, but careful implementation of several interacting components is needed, placing it at level 3.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves constructing atomic models for five stoichiometries, running geometry relaxations, finite-displacement supercell calculations for phonons (with post-processing), band structure calculations, and total-energy voltage derivations. This forms a multi-stage workflow (~4-5 interdependent steps) with dependencies on external tools (Quantum ESPRESSO, phonopy), fitting a level 3 execution score.
